tool_model: M, S = screws_from_dh(UR5_DH); M_tool = M @ make_transform(np.eye(3), [0, 0, GRIPPER_TCP]); return M_tool, S, body_screws(M_tool, S). tool_pose: make_transform(rot_z(yaw) @ rot_x(np.pi), [x, y, z]). grasp_yaw: c = box_yaw + np.arange(-4, 5) * np.pi / 2; return c[np.argmin(np.abs(wrap_to_pi(c - ref)))].

plan_waypoints: ya = grasp_yaw(box_yaw); yb = ya + wrap_to_pi(target_yaw - box_yaw); poses (pre, box_xy, HOVER_Z, ya), (grasp, box_xy, GRASP_Z, ya), (lift, box_xy, CARRY_Z, ya), (carry, target_xy, CARRY_Z, yb), (place, target_xy, GRASP_Z + 0.002, yb), (retreat, target_xy, CARRY_Z, yb); q, ok, _ = ik_lm(M_tool, B_tool, tool_pose(...), q, UR5_Q_MIN, UR5_Q_MAX). segment_reference: starts = cumsum([0] + durations); i = searchsorted(starts, t, 'right') - 1; past the end hold the last q_to; else s, sd, sdd = quintic_scaling(t - starts[i], T) and q = qa + s (qb - qa) etc.

make_controller: q_d, qd_d, qdd_d, grip = ref(t); tau = computed_torque(q[:6], qd[:6], (q_d, qd_d, qdd_d), wn**2, 2 * wn, dyn.mass, dyn.bias); append [f, f]. run_pick_and_place: model from ur5_gripper_mjcf(UR5_DH, UR5_LINKS, box_xy, box_yaw, mu=mu); ref, T = segment_reference(plan_segments(plan_waypoints(...))); ctrl = make_controller(ref, MujocoDynamics(model, n=6), squeeze=squeeze); record d.xpos[box], d.xquat[box], d.site_xpos[tcp] in before_step; run_mujoco_control(model, ctrl, concat(Q_HOME, [0, 0]), T + settle, before_step=record). final_yaw = 2 atan2(qz, qw). placement_error: yaw error = |wrap_to_pi(4 (yaw - target)) / 4|.
